name: blink
author: The Open FPGA Course
description: Lesson 00 - a counter divides 25 MHz down to human speed.
info:
## Lesson 00 - blinky

The 25 MHz board clock is far too fast to see. A **counter** is a frequency divider: bit *n* of a counter toggles every 2^n clocks. Tapping the top 8 bits gives a binary odometer slow enough to watch.

- `WIDTH` = 26, so bit 25 toggles about every 1.3 s.
- Change `WIDTH` on the constant block and rebuild to speed it up or slow it down.

This is the same logic as `blink.v` in the lesson folder - the code block body is generated from it, so both paths describe one design.
